approvalCreated: Request sent for approval by a second staff member.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.subtitle: What needs a person now, and whether user balances are fully covered.
dashboard.solvencyHint: Custody plus strategy assets compared with what the platform owes users, all from the ledger. A coverage below 1× must be investigated immediately.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Search accounts, review verification and handle risk flags.
users.searchHint: Email, user ID or referral code

flags.hint: Automatic and manual signals that need a decision. Resolve when action was taken; dismiss when it was a false alarm. Both need a note.

types.shared_signup_ip_with_referrer: Signed up from the referrer's network

user.title: User
user.subtitle: ID {{id}}
user.missingId: Open a user from the Users list.
user.selfNote: This is your own account. You cannot change its status or roles.
user.restrictText: The user can sign in and see balances but cannot deposit, invest or withdraw. They are notified.
user.freezeText: All account actions stop until the account is reinstated. Use for suspected compromise or legal holds.
user.reinstateText: Lifting a restriction needs approval from a second staff member.
user.kycApproveText: Record why the identity is considered verified (documents checked, provider reference).

role.label: Role
role.text: Role: {{role}}. A second super administrator must approve the change.

adjust.title: Balance adjustment
adjust.hint: Only to correct a documented error. It creates an approval request; the entry is posted only after a second person approves it.
adjust.text: Explain the error being corrected and where the evidence is.

deposits.title: Deposits
deposits.subtitle: Incoming payments with their chain evidence and review decisions.
deposits.approveText: The deposit is credited to the user. Record what you checked.
deposits.rejectText: The funds go to suspense and are not credited. They can be returned to the sender afterwards.
deposits.refundHint: Send the refund from the custody wallet first, then record its hash here.
deposits.returnText: The suspense balance for this deposit is closed against the refund transaction.

pool.title: Deposit addresses
pool.hint: Addresses are generated outside the platform (custody provider or offline wallet) and imported here. Keep enough available for each active network.
pool.addressesHint: One per line. Each is checked against the network's format and checksum.
pool.sharedHint: For memo networks: one address, a unique memo per user.

withdrawals.title: Withdrawals
withdrawals.subtitle: Review, approve, send and confirm withdrawal requests.
withdrawals.rules: Large requests need two different approvers. The person who records the broadcast cannot confirm completion. Mark as failed only when you are certain the funds were not sent.
withdrawals.flagsTitle: Open risk flags on this user
withdrawals.viewAddress: View the address in the explorer
withdrawals.approveText: You confirm the destination, the amount and the user's checks are in order.
withdrawals.rejectText: The reserved amount returns to the user's available balance. The reason is sent to the user.
withdrawals.processText: You take responsibility for sending this withdrawal from custody.
withdrawals.hashHint: The hash of the transaction you sent from the custody wallet.
withdrawals.broadcastText: Record that this transaction was sent. Completion is confirmed by the blockchain monitor or by a different staff member.
withdrawals.actualFeeHint: Optional. The difference from the quoted fee is booked to the platform, not the user.
withdrawals.completeText: Confirm the transaction is final on the blockchain. A different person from the sender must do this.
withdrawals.fundsNotSent: I confirm the funds were not sent and no transaction is pending.
withdrawals.failText: The reserved amount returns to the user. Use only when nothing was sent.

investments.title: Investments
investments.subtitle: Products, their legal basis and terms, and realised period results.

products.saved: Product saved. Changing terms creates a new terms version.
products.activationRules: A product can be activated only with approved legal status, a legal reference, a source of return and texts in all three languages. Changing terms creates a new version; open positions keep theirs.
products.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Cannot be changed later.
products.name: Name
products.legalReferenceHint: Licence, opinion or approval reference that permits offering this product.
products.activateText: The product becomes available to users with its current terms.
products.pauseText: No new positions can be opened. Open positions continue.
products.closeText: The product closes permanently for new positions.

results.flow: Record the realised result with evidence → preview the allocation → a second person approves → post to the ledger. Results can be negative and are posted the same way.
results.realisedOnly: Record only results that have actually been realised in a closed period, with evidence a second person can check. Never enter an estimate.
results.rateHint: Before performance fees. Negative for a loss, for example -1.2.
results.evidenceHint: Statement number, report ID or document location.
results.recorded: Result recorded. A second staff member must approve it.
results.previewText: {{count}} positions receive this result ({{rate}} gross), in proportion to the time each was open during the period.
results.noPositions: No positions were open during this period.
results.approveText: You checked the evidence and the allocation preview.
results.postText: The allocation is posted to every eligible position and cannot be undone. Positions awaiting settlement are released.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.subtitle: Rewards, relationships and abuse signals.
referrals.releaseText: The reward is credited if platform equity covers it. Record what you checked.

treasury.title: Treasury
treasury.subtitle: Solvency, reconciliation and platform capital — every figure from the ledger.
treasury.integrityOk: Ledger integrity check passed: every balance matches its entries and every transaction balances.
treasury.pausedText: Withdrawals are paused for {{assets}} after a reconciliation mismatch. Resuming needs a second approver.
treasury.evidenceHint: Statement or explorer reference for the observed balances.
treasury.transferText: Record a transfer that has already happened between platform accounts.
treasury.capitalHint: Proof that the operator added its own funds.
treasury.capitalText: Record operator funds added to custody. They increase platform equity, never user balances.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Requests that need a second person. You cannot approve your own.
approvals.approveText: The change is applied immediately after your approval.

summary.reinstate: Lift the restriction on the account

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Runtime controls and fees.
settings.rules: Tightening a control (for example pausing withdrawals) applies immediately. Relaxing it, or changing a setting marked "always", creates an approval request. Every change needs a reason and is kept in the history.

policies.always: Any change to this setting needs approval from a second staff member.
policies.when_relaxing: Tightening applies immediately; relaxing needs a second staff member.
policies.none: This setting changes immediately. The change is recorded with your reason.

keys.deposits_enabled: Accept new deposits and credit confirmed ones.
keys.withdrawals_paused_assets: Assets with withdrawals paused (set automatically after a reconciliation mismatch).
keys.funds_deposit_hold_days: Days a new deposit cannot be withdrawn (the 7-day rule).
keys.withdrawal_new_address_cooldown_hours: Hours before a newly confirmed address can be used.
keys.withdrawal_dual_approval_threshold: Amount per asset from which two approvers are needed.
keys.withdrawal_daily_limit: Maximum withdrawals per user in 24 hours, per asset.
keys.withdrawal_quote_ttl_seconds: How long a fee quote stays valid.
keys.withdrawal_require_mfa: Require two-factor authentication for addresses and withdrawals.
keys.deposits_request_ttl_hours: How long a deposit reference waits for payment.
keys.referral_deposit_rate: Reward rate on referred users' confirmed deposits.
keys.referral_profit_rate: Reward rate on referred users' realised gains.
keys.referral_require_full_coverage: Pay rewards only while platform assets cover all user balances.
keys.compliance_kyc_required_for: Actions that need verified identity (live mode).
keys.compliance_blocked_countries: Countries where accounts cannot be opened.
keys.reconciliation_tolerance: Allowed difference between observed and ledger balances.
keys.live_enabled: Send live update signals to dashboards.
keys.public_stats_enabled: Show aggregate statistics on the home page (live mode only).

fees.title: Withdrawal fee rules
fees.hint: The most specific rule in force applies: asset and network, then asset, then the default.

support.title: Support
support.subtitle: User requests. Never ask users for passwords, codes, keys or seed phrases.
support.replyHint: The user is notified by email and in their account.
support.closeText: The user will need to open a new request to continue.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.subtitle: Messages delivered to every active account as a notification.
announcements.rules: Write all three languages. Never announce returns, promotions with guaranteed gains or anything that could be read as investment advice.
announcements.confirm: This is sent to every active account and cannot be recalled.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every staff action and automated financial decision. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.

demo.label: Demo tools — test data only, never shown in live mode

system.title: System
system.subtitle: Mode: {{mode}}. Health of the database, ledger, jobs and integrations.
